status_summary: No NEPA exemption for fisheries actions and no fisheries-specific Commerce and CEQ effort to remove overlap with the Magnuson-Stevens Act was found. NOAA's revised NEPA procedures took effect 2025-06-30, and a Commerce notice published 2025-07-01 made updated department and bureau procedures effective that day, revised in consultation with CEQ after CEQ removed its own NEPA regulations in February 2025; this general streamlining applies to fisheries actions but is not specific to them. The fishery-related categorical exclusions continue, and NOAA's proposed revision of the fishery management exclusion, reprinted in a correction published 2025-07-28, is described as a clarification limited to actions that do not substantially change fishing location, timing, effort, gear or harvest levels; NOAA's NEPA page (updated 2026-06-18) still lists the exclusion changes as proposed.

timeline.event: NOAA finalizes revisions to its NEPA procedures (Companion Manual to NAO 216-6A), effective the same day, per NOAA.

Commerce publishes notice of its updated NEPA order and bureau procedures, effective 2025-07-01 and revised in consultation with CEQ, and requests comment on proposed NOAA categorical exclusion changes.
A correction notice reprints the proposed NOAA categorical exclusion changes, including a clarifying revision of the fishery management exclusion (A1), with a 30-day comment period.

title: Reduce NEPA redundancy for fisheries management actions
uncertainties: The 2025-07-01 notice was read through a summary of its Federal Register page, and the Companion Manual itself was not read, so fisheries-specific provisions inside it cannot be ruled out. Whether the proposed exclusion changes were finalized after the NOAA page update was not confirmed; a Federal Register query of NOAA documents for categorical exclusions since 2025-01-20 showed no final exclusion notice. Executive Order 14276 of 2025-04-17 on seafood competitiveness does not mention NEPA. NOAA Alaska applied the existing fishery exclusion to Bering Sea and Aleutian Islands groundfish Amendment 125 on 2025-08-20, a routine use of an exclusion rather than a change in policy. The draft's reading of the A1 change as narrowing and the notice's description as a clarification were not reconciled against the redline. In this pass the Federal Register page summary for 90 FR 28717 confirmed the notice is a notice of availability and request for comments with effective date 2025-07-01, NOAA categorical exclusion comments due 2025-07-31, and fishery exclusions A1, A3, B12, D2 and E6 receiving technical edits; the full Companion Manual and the redline were not read.
